test_list_getitem: test the pandas Series.list accessor to extract element at a given index from each list in an Arrow-backed Series
test_list_getitem_index: test the pandas Series.list accessor preserves custom integer index when extracting elements by position
test_list_getitem_slice: test the pandas Series.list accessor slices each list element returning sublists with preserved index
test_list_len: test the pandas Series.list.len() method returns the length of each list in an Arrow-backed Series
test_list_flatten: test the pandas Series.list.flatten() method concatenates all inner list elements into a single Series
